curriculum.name: close_oldest_open_request
curriculum.goal: Given a person, take that person's open requests, sort them by time, close the first one, and return it.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE close_oldest_open_request(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND REQUEST WHERE SELF.WHO={person} STATUS=OPEN
$v1 = SORT $v0 WHEN
$v2 = FIRST $v1
SET_STATUS $v2 CLOSED
RETURN $v2
END
